title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting in machine learning models. It adds a penalty to the loss function to discourage complex models.

title: Identifying Overfitting
text: If the training error is decreasing but the validation error is increasing, it indicates that the model is overfitting to the training data.

title: Effect of Regularization
text: Increasing regularization can help reduce overfitting by simplifying the model, which may improve validation error.

title: Choosing the Right Action
text: Given that the model is overfitting, what action should Alice take to improve her model's performance on validation data?
choices: No additional regularization changes are needed.
